meta.pass_rule: At least 90% of answers fully correct (grade 2), overall and in each category of 10 or more questions.
meta.notes: Held-out set: do not tune the prompt or Kotlin against it. 35 questions concern the extracted table: 20 answerable, 5 false claims, 5 with no country (Gemma must ask), 5 with a country that has no rows for the grape (Kotlin refuses before Gemma is asked). Extracted answers must credit wine enthusiasts and say 'limited evidence' for starred values. Expected rows replicate the app: country + grape spellings, any of body/tannin/acidity, province order, preferred province first, 3 at most. Profiles and keys are evaluation metadata only, never passed to Gemma.
